contains: echo "  $label: the exercise PASSED on a broken module"

skips.regex: ^fma against the exact sum: not compared here, because there is no python3 to write the cases with$
skips.text: echo "fma against the exact sum: not compared here, because there is no python3 to write the cases with"

skips.regex: ^exp, exp2, expm1, log, log1p, log2, log10, pow, sinh, cosh and tanh against the oracle: not compared here, because there is no C compiler or no python3 to build and drive the oracle with$
skips.text: [ -z "$ORACLE" ] && echo "exp, exp2, expm1, log, log1p, log2, log10, pow, sinh, cosh and tanh against the oracle: not compared here, because there is no C compiler or no python3 to build and drive the oracle with"

skips.regex: ^erf, erfc, asinh, acosh, atanh, atan, asin, acos, sin, cos, tan, lgamma, tgamma, the Bessel functions, cbrt, hypot and atan2 against the oracle: not compared here, because its CORE-MATH part did not build or run$
skips.text: [ -z "$ORACLE_CM" ] && echo "erf, erfc, asinh, acosh, atanh, atan, asin, acos, sin, cos, tan, lgamma, tgamma, the Bessel functions, cbrt, hypot and atan2 against the oracle: not compared here, because its CORE-MATH part did not build or run"

skips.regex: ^  .*: skipped, no working python3 to make the broken copy with$
skips.text: echo "  $label: skipped, no working python3 to make the broken copy with"

skips.regex: ^  the last-bit proofs of exp, exp2, expm1, log, log1p, log2, log10, pow, sinh, cosh and tanh: not run, no oracle here$
skips.text: echo "  the last-bit proofs of exp, exp2, expm1, log, log1p, log2, log10, pow, sinh, cosh and tanh: not run, no oracle here"

skips.regex: ^  the software fma's four proofs: not run here, because .* fuses with its own instruction and never runs the software arm$
skips.text: echo "  the software fma's four proofs: not run here, because $(uname -m) fuses with its own instruction and never runs the software arm" ;;

skips.regex: ^  vfmadd with its operands in the wrong order: not proven here, because this is not an x86_64 Linux with FMA3$
skips.text: echo "  vfmadd with its operands in the wrong order: not proven here, because this is not an x86_64 Linux with FMA3"

skips.regex: ^  the fma proofs: not run, no python3 to write the cases with$
skips.text: echo "  the fma proofs: not run, no python3 to write the cases with"
